tools.name: load_tool
tools.description: List the lazy tools (name and one-line summary), or show the full definitions of the named lazy tools and load them, in one call. Loading a tool does not enable it; a call to a lazy tool before it is loaded is refused.

names.description: Tool names or tools.lazy-style patterns of the lazy tools to show and load, in one call: a tool name, mcp:<server>:<tool>, mcp:<server>:* or *. Omit names to list the lazy tools. Each pattern is limited to lazy tools; the total of matched tools is limited by the profile's tools.lazy_load_max.
